advice.text: AWD fronts spinning at launch: center split more rearward / front accel diff down.
Launch wheelspin on the rears: accel diff lock down / taller 1st, or squeeze the throttle.
advice.evidence: median peak rear slip 17.42; 7/8 launches spun

advice.text: Mid-corner understeer: front ARB -2 clicks or front springs softer (mech balance up); if only in fast corners, aero balance forward instead.
advice.evidence: USI median +0.354 over 120 corners (78 understeer, 1 mid-corner front reds)

advice.text: Fronts lock first: brake balance 2-4% rearward.
advice.evidence: median deficit F 0.22 vs R 0.10; 21/50 stops

advice.text: Suspension hits full compression at speed: ride height up a notch or springs stiffer (verify on the HUD Suspension page).
advice.evidence: 72 bottoming frames above 40 mph (detector still coarse)

advice.text: Balance varies corner to corner (USI spread 0.68) — likely speed-dependent (mechanical vs aero). Split the verdict by corner speed before tuning.
Brake-lock pattern inconsistent across 50 stops (5 both-axle, 21 front-first, 2 rear-first) — more hard stops from 80+ mph before touching balance.
Launch wheelspin only in 7/8 launches — inconsistent (surface, temps or throttle?). Two more standing launches on the same surface.
